Name: development-5
Purpose: The figures of the sprints before the gates, for comparison between sprints only, from Epic 1, sprint S13 on: the same machine and versions as the manifests development to development-4, with every process of a run held to eight logical processors, because the machine keeps at most nine to ten of its twenty busy at sustained speed. No figure under this manifest judges a gate, and the manifest needs no approval (docs/work/epic-1-core.md, Acceptance, rules for every measurement).

Machine.Processor: Intel Core i9-13900H, 14 cores, 20 logical processors
Machine.Memory: 64 GiB DDR5, two modules of 32 GiB at 5,200 MT/s

Virtualization: None: the program runs on the operating system, in no container and no virtual machine
Run: One process, built in the Release configuration and started by hand from src with an affinity of the logical processors 0 to 7 (the first four performance cores with both their threads), on a machine without other heavy work; a master and the children that load from it are instances of the engine in that process, connected over TCP on the loopback interface; rounds of the two forms a figure compares alternate within a run, and runs are repeated
